create_xlnet_config: create an XLNetConfig instance with default hyperparameters for model initialization
create_xlnet_config_custom: create an XLNetConfig with custom d_model, n_layer, n_head, and vocab_size for a modified XLNet model
test_validate_architecture: test the XLNetConfig.validate_architecture method to verify d_model is divisible by n_head
review_max_position_embeddings: review the XLNetConfig.max_position_embeddings property that returns -1 indicating no sequence length limit
summarize_xlnet_config: summarize the XLNetConfig class attributes including d_model, n_layer, n_head, and attention settings
